note: Very tough; resists cracking from impacts.

name: Acrylic sheet (PMMA)
note: Stiff but brittle; cracks from impacts and from holes drilled too close to an edge.

name: Aluminium 6061-T6
note: The most common aluminium for robot frames and brackets.

name: Mild steel (1018 cold drawn)
